Project 25 IMBE encoder/decoder, fixed point, by Pavel Yazev (c) 2009, GNU General Public License version 3 or later.
Taken unchanged from OP25 (https://github.com/boatbod/op25, gr-op25_repeater/lib/imbe_vocoder).
The AMBE-3000R has no IMBE (P25 phase 1 full rate) codec, so P25 speech is coded with this in software.
IMBE is a DVSI codec: check patent and licence terms for your use.
